events.ace-parentage-revealed: Sengoku reveals that Ace is the son of Gol D. Roger.
events.whitebeard-arrives-marineford: Whitebeard arrives at Marineford with his fleet.
events.luffy-arrives-marineford: Luffy falls from the sky onto Marineford with the Impel Down escapees.
events.squard-stabs-whitebeard: Squard, deceived by the Marines, stabs Whitebeard.
events.luffy-conquerors-haki-marineford: Luffy unleashes Conqueror's Haki in the middle of the war.
events.ace-freed: Luffy frees Ace on the execution platform.
events.death-of-portgas-d-ace: Akainu kills Ace, who dies protecting Luffy.
events.death-of-edward-newgate: Whitebeard dies standing after proclaiming that the One Piece exists.
events.blackbeard-steals-gura-gura-no-mi: Blackbeard steals the power of the Gura Gura no Mi.
events.koby-stands-up: Koby stands up to Akainu to stop the war.
events.law-rescues-luffy: Law gets Luffy out of Marineford in his submarine.
events.shanks-ends-war: Shanks arrives and puts an end to the war.
